subject: Packaging options and safeguard roadmap for Greenleaf Analytics
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@greenleaf.ai>

Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia@greenleaf.ai>
Date: 2026-05-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Question on tier swap + preserving features during seasonality

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for last week's demo — the latency numbers are compelling. We're in planning for a seasonal slowdown (July–Sept) and the execs asked whether we can temporarily reduce our Dedicated capacity without losing key features (VPC, model pinning, audit logs).

Specifically:
- Can we step down to a Hosted plan for 3 months and keep VPC-level access/auditability?
- What does a downgrade do to pinned model versions and any KV/prefix caches we rely on?
- Are there prorated credits or an interim discount for a short-term stepdown?

I attached a short workbook with traffic projections and a simple migration sketch. Procurement will want a clear mutual action plan (MAM) and timeline. Can we get a package suggestion that preserves compliance artifacts and keeps an easy path back to Dedicated?

Also looping in Olivia from Ops who'll validate the technical constraints.

Best,
Samir

[Attachment: Greenleaf_Migration_Scenarios.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@greenleaf.ai>
Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia@greenleaf.ai>, markus_klein@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-11T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Question on tier swap + preserving features during seasonality

Hi Samir — thanks for the workbook, that helped. High level we can support a temporary stepdown while keeping most compliance and operational artifacts, but there are tradeoffs we should call out. Summary options below (I'll propose a MAM after you confirm which direction you prefer):

Option A — Hosted+VPC Bridge (recommended)
- Short-term move to a Hosted pool while preserving a private egress/VPC tunnel for audit logs and encrypted transport.
- Model pinning retained via our "pinned-variant" mapping; cold-start latency may increase slightly for large models.
- KV/prefix cache: we can snapshot caches and replay on re-upgrade; continuous KV cache persistence requires Dedicated.
- Pricing: prorated Hosted rate + 10% conversion fee; can include a 12-week seasonal discount (see below).

Option B — Reduced Dedicated (reserved minima)
- Keep Dedicated with lower reserved GPU count and burst to peak; guarantees pinned model performance.
- Higher baseline cost but no cache/regeneration work.

Negotiation levers we can offer without legal amendments:
- 3-month seasonal credit (up to 15% of monthly committed spend) if you commit to return to prior capacity by Oct 1.
- Preserve entitlements for model pinning and audit log retention during the stepdown window.

Next steps I suggest: 1) pick A or B, 2) agree on timeline for cache snapshot + replay (if A), 3) procurement review for credit language. I attached an internal proposed amendment showing the 12-week discount and stepdown mechanics. Can you confirm whether procurement needs explicit SLA exceptions documented?

Thanks — I'll put Markus (AM) and Laura (CS) on this thread to capture pricing mechanics and operational runbook.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

[Attachment: proposed-amendment-v2.pdf (PDF)]

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai <markus_klein@redwood.ai>

Cc: Samir Patel <samir@greenleaf.ai>
Date: 2026-05-11T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Packaging options and safeguard roadmap for Greenleaf Analytics

Quick notes from the pricing side — keeping this short so we can present clean options to procurement: 

- We can comfortably approve a 12-week seasonal credit up to 15% on committed spend; for anything beyond that we need legal sign-off.
- If they choose Hosted+VPC Bridge (Option A) we should include a re-onboarding credit: one-time credit to cover cache rehydration compute (estimate in workbook).
- For stepdown to Reduced Dedicated (Option B) we can offer a temporary seat/throughput swap that avoids full contract amendment — treat it as a configuration change in the next billing cycle.
- Suggested offer to present: 12-week 15% credit + one rehydration credit + explicit preservation of model pinning metadata. Use that as the default MAM.

I'll prepare an updated quote (numbers) and a short runbook for cache snapshot/restore. Laura, can you draft the ops runbook and estimated rehydration time so we can attach to procurement?

-Markus
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai

Kimberly / Markus — this looks great, thank you. Olivia and I reviewed the two options internally; we prefer Option A (Hosted+VPC Bridge) because it minimizes operational change for our engineers. A few quick asks before procurement will sign: 

1) Please send the updated quote with the 12-week 15% credit and the one-time cache rehydration credit included (we need a dollar-figure for our budget owner).
2) Can Laura share the ops runbook and an estimate for the cache snapshot/rehydration window (hours per model)?
3) Procurement needs a short MAM doc that lists milestones (snapshot complete, cutover date, mirrored logs verified, return-to-dedicated date).

If we can get those items by EOD Friday I'll escalate to Procurement for a quick review. Thanks again — appreciate the flexibility.

Samir
Director of Platform Engineering
Greenleaf Analytics
